content.text: Come up with an innovative solution for reducing food waste in restaurants.

One innovative solution for reducing food waste in restaurants is to implement a "Smart Ingredients Network." This system uses IoT (Internet of Things) sensors and AI to track food inventory in real-time and predict demand more accurately.

**Category:** technology

**Feasibility:** 7

**Resources Needed:**
- IoT sensors to monitor the inventory
- AI software for demand prediction and analysis
- Access to a network or database of local suppliers
- Mobile application for restaurant staff
- Training for staff to use the new system
